Notes

Money, moral judgment and street-market patter collide. Exhaustion becomes weather on a face, a warning light in a body and finally a coating of grey dust.

拿到钱就跑

就 makes the sequence immediate: once the money is in hand, leave. The hook never stays to enjoy what has been acquired. Repetition makes cash feel less like a destination than permission to escape, a pattern sharpened by the later account of having to fight for a living.

  • Lyric transcript
鸟枪换炮

鸟枪换炮 swaps a modest hunting gun for a cannon, an idiom for a dramatic improvement in means or circumstances. The scale of that upgrade contrasts with the later need to scrape together a meal. In between, the “secret” cannot be shared: the song puts the visible result of advancement next to the hidden means of obtaining it.

  • Genius community transcript
港澳牌照

套 here concerns using another vehicle’s registration identity, hence the translation’s “cloned” plates. Naming Hong Kong and Macau makes the image geographically specific; the vehicle wears credentials that do not straightforwardly belong to it. Coming after the secret of upgrading, that borrowed exterior prepares the later attack on an ugly 嘴脸, the face someone puts on.

  • Shandong court: explanation of 套牌 in a plate-sharing case
  • Lyric transcript
错过

错过, cuòguò, is a missed opportunity; 过错, guòcuò, is a mistake or wrongdoing. Swapping the same two syllables turns the question from what one failed to get into what one did wrong. Set beside “good” and “evil,” the little reversal makes morality and opportunity sound disturbingly close: the words change place as easily as the excuses do.

  • Genius community transcript
好话赖话都被你说完了

好话 and 赖话 place favorable and unfavorable speech in the same person’s mouth. 说完了 suggests they have used up both sides, leaving no position they have not already occupied. The accusation is not simply dishonesty; it is opportunistic flexibility, immediately reduced to the need to secure a bite to eat.

  • Lyric transcript
讨口饭

讨口饭 or 讨口饭吃 can mean scraping out a living. The small mouthful makes basic subsistence the scale of the effort. Beside the insistence on getting money and running, it keeps the cash imagery tied to survival as well as ambition.

  • Lyric text
拼命生活的模样

拼命 means exerting oneself desperately, with 命, life, embedded in the effort to live. That effort becomes an image captured by somebody else. The line introduces an asymmetry between doing the exhausting work and possessing a picture of it, preparing the later sales patter to sound like someone marketing another person’s struggle.

  • Lyric transcript
局部多云

局部多云 is “partly cloudy,” the phrasing of a weather report. Applying it to 脸色, facial appearance or expression, turns a bad mood into a forecast.

  • Genius community transcript
太累了自然会变懒

自然 makes the connection sound self-evident: too much exhaustion produces inactivity. The sentence reverses the usual moral accusation that laziness explains a person’s difficulties. Here depletion comes first. Its ordinary, almost practical tone interrupts the more theatrical boasts and gives the song’s bad mood a bodily cause.

  • Lyric transcript
全场清仓

全场清仓 and 大甩卖 are the language of a shop clearing stock: everything must go. Later, 走过路过不要错过 calls out to passersby. Placing those public sales calls amid private exhaustion makes suffering sound as though it has been put on display. The speaker keeps getting money and running, while the lyric keeps breaking into sales patter.

  • Genius community transcript
老奸巨猾

老奸巨猾 describes someone deeply practiced in deceit or cunning. There is no fox in the Chinese; English supplies its own familiar animal for that character. With a loach held at the mouth in the previous line, 不会咬 works both as refusing food and refusing to be lured in.

  • Lyric text
苦变成脂肪

苦 is hardship, suffering, and bitterness; 脂肪 gives it a bodily storage place. The image makes blocked expression accumulate as matter. It belongs with the cloudy face and flashing body in the surrounding verse: what cannot be released in words returns as a surface or signal that others can see.

  • Lyric transcript
红绿灯闪烁

The body becomes a traffic signal while it is barely managing to stay upright. Red and green offer incompatible instructions—stop and go—so the image fits a person required to continue while showing signs of strain. The next hawker call urges people not to miss the spectacle, making private warning signs into public attraction.

  • Lyric transcript
嘴硬

嘴硬 is refusing to concede or continuing to talk tough despite contrary evidence. The next line’s 心虚 is inward unease, guilt, or lack of confidence. Together they split the person into a defiant mouth and an insecure interior; the praise of how “cool” and “beautiful” this looks carries a mocking edge.

  • Lyric text
灰

灰 means grey as a color, but also dust or ash as matter. 一身灰 coats the whole body with it. The title therefore becomes something lived on the skin, after cloudy expressions and flashing red-green signals have made emotion visible. It also answers the earlier neat questions about good and evil with a body that is anything but cleanly divided.

About Jackzebra and this mixtape

Zhuang Zhuang Mixtape arrived on Surf Gang on October 2, 2026: 55 tracks, opening with Sour and closing with Sweet. Its cast widens from YoungQueenz on Poker Face to User116, Effie, kuru, yoyi, 春 and 南部犯罪份子. Aghast has a production credit on every track from Hitman through Snatch, giving that stretch a shared collaborator behind its changing scenes.

Surf Gang release · Artist credits

Jackzebra told AVYSS that he writes while singing over a beat he has listened to repeatedly, keeping the images in his head central. He values the room Mandarin leaves for indirect meanings. Listen for ordinary phrases becoming physical scenes: familiarity becomes cooking, authority becomes family seniority, and a tired saying suddenly turns into a threat.

AVYSS interview, 2024

In STATIC, he describes mixtapes as a format for letting ideas flow, reserving an official debut album for later. In a separate conversation about Above & Beyond, he compared that earlier tape to a collection of his producer friends’ work. The credits here likewise reward attention: long-running collaborators sit alongside guests working in Mandarin, Korean and English.

STATIC interview · Sabukaru interview, 2025

The small details connect to his stated interests: he has described playing Temple Run in transit and before shows, watching Top Boy, and wanting to score White Oleander. These give the songs specific points of contact with his life. The notes follow those connections alongside the lyrics’ jokes, invented scenes and competing voices.

His recommendations in Perfectly Imperfect · Dazed interview, 2025 · Interview questionnaire, 2025

Jackzebra has pushed back on being made to represent all of China’s underground. These notes stay close to the words: what an expression usually means, what changes in this line, and how another song answers it. Cultural references have sources; interpretations rest on details you can hear or read in the song.
